import sys

PROPOSAL = ROOT / 'dist-newstyle/priority4-live/exference-nested-forall-graph-proposal-v1'
BASE = ROOT / 'dist-newstyle/build/x86_64-windows/ghc-9.12.4/djex-2026.7.17'

import behavior_runtime as runtime

REQUIRED = ['exference-engine-tests', 'exference-tests', 'synthesis-length-tests',
            'djex-tests', 'djex-api-tests', 'djex-cli-tests']
ADDITIONAL = ['exference-frontend-api-tests', 'exference-cli-tests', 'synthesis-tests',
              'synthesis-certificate-tests', 'synthesis-term-graph-fingerprint-tests',
              'djinn-source-graph-tests', 'djinn-source-graph-private-tests',
              'djinn-tests', 'djinn-cli-tests']
SUITES = REQUIRED + ADDITIONAL

def hashes(paths):
    return {str(p.resolve()): runtime.sha256(p) for p in sorted(set(paths), key=str)}

def sources():
    files = [Path(__file__), ROOT / 'djex.cabal', ROOT / 'test-church/behavior_runtime.py',
             ROOT / 'dist-newstyle/cache/plan.json']
    if (ROOT / 'cabal.project').is_file():
        files.append(ROOT / 'cabal.project')
    for directory in ['src', 'exference', 'synthesis', 'test-integration', 'test-api',
                      'test-cli', 'test-support', 'djinn/src-core', 'djinn/src-internal',
                      'djinn/test-source-graph', 'djinn/test-source-graph-private',
                      'djinn/test-unit', 'djinn/test-cli']:
        files += [p for p in (ROOT / directory).rglob('*') if p.is_file()
                  and p.suffix in {'.hs', '.lhs', '.hsc', '.py', '.txt', '.golden', '.inc'}
                  and not {'dist-newstyle', 'results', '__pycache__'}.intersection(p.parts)]
    files += [p for p in PROPOSAL.rglob('*') if p.is_file()
              and p.suffix in {'.hs', '.txt', '.json', '.patch'}]
    return files

def executable(path):
    located = shutil.which(str(path))
    resolved = Path(located or path).resolve()
    if not resolved.is_file():
        raise ValueError('missing executable: ' + str(path))
    return resolved

def checked_process(processes, label, command, *, cwd, env=None):
    result = processes.run(label, command, cwd=cwd, env=env)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(label + ' failed with exit ' + str(result.returncode))
    return result

def required_leaves(suite):
    paths = ([ROOT / 'exference/test-engine/NestedForallGraphSpec.hs',
              ROOT / 'exference/test-engine/ImplicitConstructorGraphSpec.hs']
             if suite == 'exference-engine-tests' else
             [PROPOSAL / 'LengthRootTests.fragment.hs',
              PROPOSAL / 'root-closure-review/Regression.fragment.hs']
             if suite == 'synthesis-length-tests' else [])
    names = {
        'synthesis-tests': ['preserve exact source lambda boundaries through erased forall and resealing'],
        'synthesis-term-graph-fingerprint-tests': [
            'fresh fingerprint resealing retains exact source lambda projection cost'],
    }.get(suite, [])
    if suite == 'exference-engine-tests':
        paths += [ROOT / 'exference/test-engine/GivenEvidenceSpec.hs']
        names += ['live global method search retains the exact inferred Given graph',
                  'matching respects the work guard before certifying uniqueness']
    if suite == 'djinn-source-graph-private-tests':
        paths += [ROOT / 'djinn/test-source-graph-private/DjinnContextSpec.hs']
    if suite == 'synthesis-tests':
        names += ["a constraint-only root requires its lexical signature",
                  "a matching full signature scopes the actual constraint-only selection",
                  "a different result signature cannot name a graph's skolems",
                  "an invalid source binder cannot enter generated Haskell",
                  "a free source variable cannot authorize a root signature"]
    if suite == 'djex-tests':
        names += ['djinn global', 'djinn local', 'exference global', 'exference local']
    if suite == 'djex-cli-tests':
        names += ['REPL preflight forwards explicitly scoped constraint-only parameters']
    for path in paths:
        leaves = re.findall(r'testCase\s+"([^"]+)"', path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if not leaves:
            raise ValueError('missing new regression source inventory: ' + str(path))
        names += leaves
    return names

def run_suite(args, suite, output, processes, environment, report):
    binary = args.build_base / f't/{suite}/build/{suite}/{suite}.exe'
    row = {'suite': suite, 'status': 'running', 'filtered': False,
           'executable': str(binary)}
    report['rows'].append(row)
    try:
        before = runtime.sha256(binary)
        row['executable_sha256'] = before
        listed = checked_process(processes, suite + '-inventory',
            [binary, '--list-tests'], cwd=ROOT, env=environment)
        names = [line for line in listed.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
        if not names or len(names) != len(set(names)) or any('Usage:' in name for name in names):
            raise ValueError('empty, duplicate or invalid complete test inventory')
        row.update(inventory=names, inventory_count=len(names),
                   required_regression_leaves=required_leaves(suite))
        for name in row['required_regression_leaves']:
            if sum(item.endswith('.' + name) or item == name for item in names) != 1:
                raise ValueError('missing or ambiguous required regression: ' + name)
        runtime.write_json(output / 'results.json', report)
        result = processes.run(suite,
            [binary, '-j1', '--color=never', '--timeout=' + args.test_timeout],
            cwd=ROOT, env=environment)
        row['exit_code'] = result.returncode
        summaries = re.findall(r'^All (\d+) tests passed \(([0-9.]+)s\)\s*$',
                               result.stdout + '\n' + result.stderr, re.M)
        if result.returncode or len(summaries) != 1 or int(summaries[0][0]) != len(names):
            raise ValueError('complete passing summary does not match actual inventory')
        row.update(status='passed', passed_count=int(summaries[0][0]),
                   seconds=float(summaries[0][1]))
    except Exception as error:
        row.update(status='failed', failure=f'{type(error).__name__}: {error}')
    finally:
        row['executable_unchanged'] = binary.is_file() and runtime.sha256(binary) == row.get('executable_sha256')
        if not row['executable_unchanged']:
            row['status'] = 'failed'
        runtime.write_json(output / 'results.json', report)
        print(suite + ': ' + row['status'], flush=True)

def run_probe(args, output, processes, environment, report):
    row = {'kind': 'exact source-witness graph/typed-rendering/GHC predicate replay',
           'status': 'running', 'live_search_acceptance': False}
    report['rows'].append(row)
    work = output / 'maybe-either'
    work.mkdir()
    try:
        manifest = json.loads((PROPOSAL / 'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        provenance = manifest['exact_witness_provenance']
        receipt = Path(provenance['receipt'])
        if runtime.sha256(receipt) != provenance['sha256']:
            raise ValueError('original failed-cell receipt changed')
        original = json.loads(receipt.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        cells = [c for c in original['cells'] if c['engine'] == 'exference' and c['operation'] == 'maybeEither']
        if len(cells) != 1:
            raise ValueError('original maybeEither cell is not unique')
        cell = cells[0]
        signature = PROPOSAL / 'MaybeEither.original-type.txt'
        if (runtime.sha256(signature) != provenance['type_file_sha256']
                or signature.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip() != cell['type']
                or cell['provider_inventory'] != []):
            raise ValueError('full original type or empty provider inventory changed')
        commands = Path(cell['command_path'])
        if runtime.sha256(commands) != cell['command_sha256']:
            raise ValueError('original command capture changed')
        exact_query = ':synth ' + cell['name'] + ' :: ' + cell['search_type'] + ' where ' + cell['predicate']
        if commands.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines().count(exact_query) != 1:
            raise ValueError('predicate/full search type are not the exact original query')
        exact_inputs = hashes([receipt, commands, signature])
        row.update(original_receipt_sha256=runtime.sha256(receipt), original_cell=cell,
                   original_command_sha256=runtime.sha256(commands))
        probe_source = PROPOSAL / 'MaybeEitherGraphProbe.hs'
        binary = work / 'MaybeEitherGraphProbe.exe'
        objects = work / 'objects'
        objects.mkdir()
        plan = json.loads((ROOT / 'dist-newstyle/cache/plan.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        components = [unit for unit in plan['install-plan'] if
                      unit.get('pkg-name') == 'djex' and
                      unit.get('component-name') == 'test:exference-engine-tests']
        if len(components) != 1:
            raise ValueError('private checker test component is not unique in the current build plan')
        units = list(components[0]['depends'])
        for name in ['directory', 'filepath', 'pretty']:
            matches = [unit['id'] for unit in plan['install-plan'] if unit.get('pkg-name') == name]
            if len(matches) != 1:
                raise ValueError('probe dependency is not unique in the current plan: ' + name)
            if matches[0] not in units:
                units.append(matches[0])
        row['probe_package_unit_ids'] = units
        command = [args.cabal, 'exec', '--', args.ghc, '--make', '-O0', '-Wall', '-Werror',
                   '-hide-all-packages',
                   '-fforce-recomp', '-i', '-i' + str(ROOT / 'exference/test-engine'),
                   '-i' + str(ROOT / 'exference/src-core'), '-i' + str(ROOT / 'synthesis/internal'),
                   '-outputdir', objects, probe_source, '-o', binary]
        for unit in units:
            command += ['-package-id', unit]
        checked_process(processes, 'maybe-either-probe-compile', command, cwd=ROOT, env=environment)
        digest = runtime.sha256(binary)
        rendered = work / 'rendered'
        checked_process(processes, 'maybe-either-probe', [binary, signature, rendered], cwd=ROOT, env=environment)
        if runtime.sha256(binary) != digest:
            raise ValueError('probe executable changed')
        candidate = rendered / 'Candidate.hs'
        exact = candidate.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        # Validate the full wrapper; preserve every generated candidate byte.
        if ('generated :: ' + signature.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) not in exact:
            raise ValueError('typed rendering does not retain the original full signature')
        if re.findall(r'^\s*import\b', exact, re.M) or exact.count('\ngenerated = ') != 1:
            raise ValueError('candidate has unexpected imports or definition inventory')
        keys = [candidate, rendered / 'compatibility.txt', rendered / 'graph.txt']
        before = hashes(keys)
        name_pattern = r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_'])" + re.escape(cell['name']) + r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_'])"
        predicate, replacements = re.subn(name_pattern, 'Candidate.generated', cell['predicate'])
        if replacements < 1 or re.sub(r'\bCandidate\.generated\b', cell['name'], predicate) != cell['predicate']:
            raise ValueError('predicate rebinding did not preserve every original observation')
        (rendered / 'predicate.original.txt').write_text(cell['predicate'], encoding='utf-8')
        (rendered / 'predicate.replay.txt').write_text(predicate, encoding='utf-8')
        main = '\n'.join([
            '{-# LANGUAGE RankNTypes, ImpredicativeTypes, ScopedTypeVariables, TypeApplications #-}',
            'module Main (main) where', 'import Prelude', 'import qualified Prelude',
            'import qualified Candidate', 'import qualified Control.Exception as E',
            'import qualified System.Timeout as T', 'import qualified System.Exit as Exit',
            'main :: IO ()', 'main = do',
            '  result <- T.timeout 2000000 (E.try (E.evaluate (' + predicate + ')) :: IO (Either E.SomeException Bool))',
            '  case result of', '    Just (Right True) -> putStrLn "PASS exact-maybeEither-typed-graph"',
            '    _ -> print result >> Exit.exitFailure', ''])
        (rendered / 'Main.hs').write_text(main, encoding='utf-8')
        replay_inputs = hashes([rendered / 'Main.hs', rendered / 'predicate.original.txt', rendered / 'predicate.replay.txt'])
        replay = rendered / 'replay.exe'
        checked_process(processes, 'maybe-either-exact-ghc',
            [args.ghc, '-v0', '-O0', '-fforce-recomp', '-i', '-i' + str(rendered),
             '-outputdir', rendered, rendered / 'Main.hs', '-o', replay], cwd=rendered, env=environment)
        replay_hash = runtime.sha256(replay)
        result = checked_process(processes, 'maybe-either-exact-execute', [replay], cwd=rendered, env=environment)
        if result.stdout.splitlines() != ['PASS exact-maybeEither-typed-graph']:
            raise ValueError('missing, duplicate or foreign replay pass label')
        if hashes(keys) != before or hashes(map(Path, replay_inputs)) != replay_inputs or runtime.sha256(replay) != replay_hash:
            raise ValueError('candidate, graph, predicate or replay executable changed')
        if hashes(map(Path, exact_inputs)) != exact_inputs:
            raise ValueError('original receipt, full signature or actual command changed')
        row.update(status='passed', artifacts=before, replay_sources=replay_inputs,
                   original_inputs=exact_inputs,
                   probe_executable_sha256=digest, replay_executable_sha256=replay_hash,
                   predicate_candidate_references=replacements, evaluation_timeout_seconds=2)
    except Exception as error:
        row.update(status='failed', failure=f'{type(error).__name__}: {error}')
    finally:
        runtime.write_json(output / 'results.json', report)

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--mode', choices=['suites', 'probe'], default='suites')
    parser.add_argument('--suite', choices=SUITES, action='append')
    parser.add_argument('--build-base', type=Path, default=BASE)
    parser.add_argument('--process-timeout', type=float, default=1800)
    parser.add_argument('--test-timeout', default='180s')
    parser.add_argument('--ghc', default='ghc')
    parser.add_argument('--cabal', default='cabal')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.process_timeout <= 0 or args.mode == 'probe' and args.suite:
        raise ValueError('invalid guard or suite selection for probe mode')
    selected = args.suite or SUITES
    if len(selected) != len(set(selected)):
        raise ValueError('duplicate suite selection')
    args.ghc, args.cabal = executable(args.ghc), executable(args.cabal)
    output = runtime.prepare_output_directory(args.output.resolve())
    processes = runtime.Processes(output, args.process_timeout)
    helper_paths = [args.ghc, args.cabal] + [args.build_base / f'x/{name}/build/{name}/{name}.exe'
        for name in ['djex', 'djinn', 'exference', 'djex-fake-cabal', 'djex-fake-z3']]
    environment = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.upper().startswith('TASTY_')}
    environment['djex_datadir'] = str(ROOT)
